findings.title: FinceptTerminal
findings.note: Search surfaced FIVE separate repos with byte-identical descriptions across unrelated orgs/owners (twoliness/finceptterminal, Fincept-Terminal/FinceptTerminal, Fincept-Corporation/FinceptTerminal, ymys/FinceptTerminal-crypto-trading, INJprotocol/finceptterminal) -- the last two names belong to a crypto-trading fork and an Injective Protocol-branded fork respectively. Identical boilerplate descriptions across multiple orgs including a crypto-protocol org is a star-farming / repo-cloning pattern, not necessarily malicious but not a legitimate signal of organic trending either. Consistent with the persona.md hallusquatting-defense mindset even though no package install was involved here (this is a full desktop app, not a pip/npm dependency) -- treating with skepticism rather than recommending. Not staged for wiki inclusion; noting the pattern here for anyone reviewing this scan later.
